module_organizations_purpose: The Organizations module allows you to maintain a shared database of organizations, offices, and facilities.
section_organizations: Organizations section — this is where we manage the list of organizations
create_organization: We go to the form for creating a new organization
section_offices: Offices section — this is where we manage organization offices
create_office: We go to the form for creating a new office
section_facilities: Facilities section — this is where we manage operational facilities
create_facility: We go to the form for creating a new facility
org_type_ngo: We select the organization type: NGO
org_comments: Description and notes about the organization (optional)
org_comments_value: An organization supporting local aid activities.
office_country: Country where the office is located (optional)
office_map_icon: Button for indicating the office on the map (optional)
office_comments_value: Main office coordinating activities in Warsaw.
facility_type_food_distribution: We select the facility type: Food distribution point
facility_country: Country where the facility is located (optional)
facility_map_icon: Button for indicating the facility on the map (optional)
facility_comments_value: A facility supporting the distribution of in-kind aid.
